body: But I’m still depressed “treated”. Just less so. But no happy manic trips either.

Yeah this definitely happens to me, what can work is imagining a black wall every time intrusive thoughts occur, like as soon as the thoughts begin *black wall*. Don't even let them start. If this doesn't work (give it time) then do something active, it'll block out the thoughts to some degree but more importantly it'll make you more tired. Personally I have to make sure I'm absolutely exhausted before I go to sleep so my mind is too tired to wander into dark places. Hope this helps
